imageUpload.instructions: Run the installed client.js on the agent computer with these arguments using its configured Node executable. Expand the fixed clientPath against the local user home. Replace only ABSOLUTE_IMAGE_PATH and UNIQUE_UPLOAD_ID. Use this returned hostId, never a Canvas/session ID. The client resolves the address/port and loads authentication automatically. Keep this document current/open. Reuse the returned source in Widget HTML/CSS or place_image.

nodes.label: stdio 桥接进程
nodes.subtitle: TLS 校验 · 连接复用
details: 轻量桥接进程，不启动完整 PenEcho 应用。
读取本机凭据与发现缓存，经 HTTPS /mcp 复用连接。
HTTP 空闲清理不终止仍打开 stdin 的桥；恢复连接不自动重放已提交的写请求。

nodes.label: HTTPS MCP 接入
nodes.subtitle: 认证 · 传输会话
details: HTTPS listener 负责认证与传输会话。RPC 校验工具输入，分派到目标浏览器与文档。
图片上传和工具调用共享 HTTPS 接入；不同端口候选不代表多台服务器。
共用画布操作管理版本、hash、幂等和虚拟文件读写。
